title: The dashboard's browser tab reads "Import notification service | Import notification service"; Design release 1 names the page "Dashboard"

finding.frontend: The layout builds every page title as the page name, a pipe, then the service name (src/server/app/shared/layout.njk:17). The dashboard's page name is the service name — copy.title is "Import notification service" (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/dashboard/copy/copy.en.js:2), passed as pageTitle at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/dashboard/controller.js:70 — so all seven captured dashboard screens have a title reading "Import notification service | Import notification service". A trader with several tabs open cannot tell the dashboard from any other page of the service, and a screen reader announces the service name twice.
finding.prototype: Design release 1 names the page "Dashboard" and shows the same word as the caption above the heading, while the heading itself stays "Import notification service" (app/views/dashboard.html:12). The tab reads "Dashboard - Import notification service - GOV.UK". Every other Design release 1 page names itself after what it asks, and none repeats the service name.
finding.difference: Give the dashboard a page name of its own — "Dashboard" — and keep the h1 as the service name, which is what the design does. That means separating the title passed as pageTitle at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/dashboard/controller.js:70 from the heading rendered at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/dashboard/template.njk:27, and adding a second key beside copy.title in src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/dashboard/copy/copy.en.js:2. The separator and the absence of a "GOV.UK" suffix are not in question; only the page name is.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding a dashboard title that is not "Import notification service | Import notification service" in the captured DOM of any of the seven frontend dashboard screens.
finding.verification: Ran the falsifier: extracted <title> from all seven captured frontend dashboard files (fe-dashboard, -populated, -empty, -sorted, -deleted, -new-draft, -search-no-results) and every one reads "Import notification service | Import notification service". dr1-dashboard.html reads "Dashboard - Import notification service - GOV.UK". Read src/server/app/shared/layout.njk:17 (pageTitle, pipe, serviceName), the dashboard copy at copy/copy.en.js:2 and the controller at controller.js:70 where copy.title is passed as pageTitle, and app/views/dashboard.html:12 ({% set pageName = "Dashboard" %}). The empty controls array is right here: a <title> has no element to crop. CORRECT.

relatedTo.why: Design release 1 uses the same word, "Dashboard", as the page name and as the caption above the heading.
